newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu started a two-day visit to the Czech Republic. Constantinescu said before departure for Prague he hoped to come back with concrete results in the field of economic cooperation.
* Romania and the Czech Republic regard their integration into NATO structures as cooperation and not competition, Czech President Vaclav Havel said after his meeting with Constantinescu.
* Romania's Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea will pay a two-day visit to Hungary starting March 12.

The partenership between Romania and Hungary forms the basis of stability in the region and will be one of the main arguments in favour of the two countries' joining NATO structures, Ciorbea said in a interview with MTI
